Advertisement
Applications are invited for one post of Research Associate (RA) in the SERB-sponsored research
project entitled “Functional characterization of TaMSL5-D of bread wheat” to be executed at the
Department of Botany, Panjab University, Chandigarh with the following terms and conditions:
Position: RA – 1 (One)
Duration: Up to December 2024 and co-terminus with the project.
Emoluments: Rs 47,000 p.m. plus HRA as per guidelines.
Minimum Qualifications:
Ph.D. in Botany/Biotechnology or M. Tech. (Biotechnology) plus three years of research
experience with one published research paper in the SCI journal.
Desirable qualification:
Research experience in the area of gene cloning, yeast two-hybrid assay and molecular,
biochemical and physiological analyses of transgenic plants will be preferred.
Age limit: 40 and 45 years for male and female candidates respectively.
Interested candidates may send their application by post, by hand, or by e-mail, along with complete
biodata and attested copies of the necessary certificates and research publications to the undersigned
by 5th September 2023.
Candidates will be shortlisted as per academic qualifications and research experience strictly relevant
to the project. The shortlisted candidates will be informed by email and notice board of the
departmental website. The interview date will be communicated to the shortlisted candidates, which
will be held from 11:00 AM in the Office of the Chairperson, Department of Botany, Panjab
University, Chandigarh. The candidate must report along with the original certificates at least one
hour before the scheduled time. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. The position is
purely temporary and co-terminus with the project.
(S K Upadhyay)
Principal Investigator
Email: skupadhyay@pu.ac.in
